name: Nay 1-3-5-3-1
pedagogy: A CCM and belt-prep staple popularised by Speech Level Singing and common in musical-theatre belt work. The bright, nasal /næ/ (closer to 'nyah' than 'nay') encourages twang, a narrowing above the larynx that adds ring and firms vocal-fold closure, building the chest-mix and belt coordination used in theatrical and contemporary commercial styles. Some methods let the larynx rise on this sound; others use it only briefly on the way to a stable larynx.
